evidence: Skill procedure (quality-checks.md s.7): ask the smallest submission satisfying the brief; defect if a static page, single CRUD screen or mock satisfies it. ASK: task/instruction.md:1 asks to 'build HireOps' from scratch; the agent image (environment/Dockerfile) leaves /app empty except .gitkeep, so no starter app is tweaked. The brief plus hireops_rules.md demand a multi-role (Recruiter/HM/Observer/Candidate) server-backed product: one-step stage moves, interview capacity, reject/reopen, per-stage manual ordering, optimistic version 409 with actor name, all-or-none bulk moves, single-use undo, activity log, live updates within 15s preserving focus/draft/scroll, paged conversations (30) with place-keeping, per-person unread and seen, drafts surviving reload/sign-out isolated per user, candidate data redaction, SQLite persistence across restart (instruction.md:3,5,7,9,13,15; hireops_rules.md s.1-9). Golden is ~1,400 lines of JS (index.js 438, board.js 373, threads.js 224, app.js 213...). The smallest conforming submission is a real full-stack app. GRADING SEPARATES STUB FROM BUILD: gates/render criterion hro_gate_render (judge.toml:22-24) rejects 'A static picture or only a health response'; gates/constraints hro_gate_shared (judge.toml:22-24) requires UI-created job+candidate read back in an independent browser context as a different user, explicitly rejecting 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'. So a static page or mock gets reward 0 (score.py:41,48). Weak-app probe (source arithmetic, not a run): a plausible persistent CRUD app (sign-in, open job with validation, add candidate with email rules, restart persistence, no moves/conversations/live) passes both gates and could earn functional rows hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_restart 1.5 = 3.5/58.5 = 0.060, just above the template-controlled functional floor 0.05 (scoring.toml [floors], identical to template). Polish (12.0 weight) is entirely live-update/conversation/draft behaviour -> ~0. Visual likert (6.0) could award partial credit for a tidy board. Estimated stub reward ~0.6*0.06 + 0.2*0 + 0.2*(<=0.8) ~= 0.04-0.2, versus a full build near the top; 39 of 43 functional rows (55/58.5 weight) need real move/concurrency/conversation work. A trivial tweak or stub therefore cannot earn the reward; at most a small residual. Conforming alternative that could fail: brief leaves routes/layout/transport free (instruction.md:11,13; hireops_rules.md s.5 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all acceptable'; app_context.md 'never assume the reference implementation's routes'), so a real different-shaped build is not penalised under this row. RISK (why risk=true): raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the six indexed artifacts (hashes verified) are scripted golden observations only. The stub-vs-build separation above is source reasoning, not a measured weak-app reward. The low floor (0.05, template-controlled, not to be edited) lets a CRUD-only app clear the floor with a small nonzero reward; this is a P3 Note-level observation, not a defect of this row.
